crossRefs.note: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

parallels.note: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

translations.web: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.
translations.bsb: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
translations.kjv: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
translations.asv: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful; With the perfect man thou wilt show thyself perfect;
